metadata.title: An iterative thresholding algorithm for linear inverse problems with a sparsity constraint

nodes.name: Linear inverse problem
nodes.statement: Given a bounded operator $K: \cB_{\mathrm{OBJ}} \to \cB_{\mathrm{IM}}$ and observed data $g = Kf + e$ with noise $e$ of bounded $L^2$-norm, recover $f$ from $g$.

nodes.name: Pseudo-solution and generalized solution
nodes.statement: A pseudo-solution minimizes the discrepancy $\Delta(f) = \|Kf - g\|^2$. The generalized solution $f^{\dagger}$ is the minimum-norm element among pseudo-solutions: $f^{\dagger} = \arg\min\{\|f\|;\, f \text{ minimizes } \Delta(f)\} \in \mathrm{N}(K)^{\perp}$.

nodes.name: Tikhonov regularization functional
nodes.statement: The quadratic-penalized functional $\Delta(f) + \mu \|f\|_{\cH}^2 = \|Kf - g\|^2 + \mu \|f\|_{\cH}^2$ with regularization parameter $\mu > 0$, whose minimizer is $f_\mu = (K^*K + \mu I)^{-1} K^* g$.

nodes.name: Weighted $\ell^p$-penalized functional $\Phi_{\mathbf{w},p}$
nodes.statement: Given an orthonormal basis $(\varphi_\gamma)_{\gamma \in \Gamma}$ of $\cH$ and positive weights $\mathbf{w} = (w_\gamma)$, define $\Phi_{\mathbf{w},p}(f) = \|Kf - g\|^2 + \sum_{\gamma} w_\gamma |\langle f, \varphi_\gamma \rangle|^p$ for $1 \le p \le 2$.

nodes.name: Soft-thresholding operator $S_\mu$
nodes.statement: $S_\mu(x) = x - \mu/2$ if $x \geq \mu/2$; $S_\mu(x) = 0$ if $|x| < \mu/2$; $S_\mu(x) = x + \mu/2$ if $x \leq -\mu/2$.

nodes.name: Frame in Hilbert space
nodes.statement: A set $\{\psi_n\}_{n \in \N} \subset \cH$ is a frame if there exist $A, B > 0$ such that $B^{-1} \sum_n |\langle v, \psi_n \rangle|^2 \leq \|v\|^2 \leq A^{-1} \sum_n |\langle v, \psi_n \rangle|^2$ for all $v \in \cH$. The frame is tight when $A = B$.

nodes.name: Surrogate functional ${\Phi}^{\mathrm{SUR}}_{\mathbf{w},p}(f;a)$
nodes.statement: ${\Phi}^{\mathrm{SUR}}_{\mathbf{w},p}(f;a) = \Phi_{\mathbf{w},p}(f) + \|f - a\|^2 - \|K(f - a)\|^2$, designed so the variational equations decouple in the $\varphi_\gamma$-basis.

nodes.name: Generalized scalar shrinkage $S_{w,p}$
nodes.statement: For $p > 1$, $S_{w,p} = (F_{w,p})^{-1}$ where $F_{w,p}(x) = x + \frac{wp}{2}\mathrm{sign}(x)|x|^{p-1}$. For $p = 1$, $S_{w,1}$ coincides with the soft-threshold $S_w$ of definition DP111.5.

nodes.name: Vector shrinkage operator $\mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}$
nodes.statement: $\mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}(h) = \sum_\gamma S_{w_\gamma,p}(h_\gamma)\, \varphi_\gamma$ where $h_\gamma = \langle h, \varphi_\gamma\rangle$.

nodes.name: Iteration operator $\mathbf{T}$
nodes.statement: $\mathbf{T} f = \mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}\left(f + K^*(g - Kf)\right)$, so that the iterates of the algorithm satisfy $f^n = \mathbf{T}^n f^0$.

nodes.name: Triple-bar norm $\Vvert f \Vvert_{\mathbf{w},p}$
nodes.statement: $\Vvert f \Vvert_{\mathbf{w},p} = \left[\sum_\gamma w_\gamma |\langle f, \varphi_\gamma\rangle|^p\right]^{1/p}$ for $1 \le p \le 2$.

nodes.name: Regularized solution and regularization method
nodes.statement: $f^*_{\mu(\epsilon),\mathbf{w},p;g}$ is a regularized solution if $\mu(\epsilon) \to 0$ and $\sup_{\|g - Kf_o\| \le \epsilon} \|f^*_{\mu(\epsilon)} - f_o\| \to 0$ as $\epsilon \to 0$. The minimization defines a regularization method.

nodes.name: Modulus of continuity $M(\epsilon, \rho)$
nodes.statement: $M(\epsilon, \rho) = \sup\{\|h\|;\, \|Kh\| \le \epsilon,\, \Vvert h \Vvert_{\mathbf{w},p} \le \rho\}$, the best-possible reconstruction-error rate under a prior $\Vvert f_o\Vvert_{\mathbf{w},p} \le \rho$.

nodes.name: Modulus of convergence $M_\mu(\epsilon, \rho)$
nodes.statement: $M_\mu(\epsilon,\rho) = \sup\{\|f^*_{\mu;g} - f\|;\, f \in \cH,\, g \in \cH',\, \|Kf - g\| \le \epsilon,\, \Vvert f \Vvert_{\mathbf{w},p} \le \rho\}$, the worst-case error of the proposed estimator.

nodes.name: Besov-equivalent wavelet norm
nodes.statement: For wavelet basis $(\Psi_\lambda)$ and $\sigma = s + d(\frac{1}{2} - \frac{1}{p}) \ge 0$, $\VVert f \VVert_{s,p} = \left(\sum_\lambda 2^{\sigma p|\lambda|} |\langle f, \Psi_\lambda\rangle|^p\right)^{1/p}$ is equivalent to the Besov norm on $B^s_{p,p}(\mathbb{R}^d)$.

nodes.name: Smoothing operator of order $\alpha$
nodes.statement: $K$ is smoothing of order $\alpha$ if there exist $A_\ell, A_u > 0$ such that $A_\ell^2 \sum_\lambda 2^{-2|\lambda|\alpha} |h_\lambda|^2 \le \|Kh\|^2 \le A_u^2 \sum_\lambda 2^{-2|\lambda|\alpha} |h_\lambda|^2$ for all $h$.

nodes.name: Iteration formula $f^n = \mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}(f^{n-1} + K^*(g - Kf^{n-1}))$
nodes.statement: $f^n = \mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}\left(f^{n-1} + K^*(g - Kf^{n-1})\right)$, $n = 1, 2, \ldots$, with $f^0 \in \cH$ arbitrary.

nodes.name: Variational equation for $\Phi_{\mathbf{w},p}$
nodes.statement: $\langle K^*Kf, \varphi_\gamma\rangle - \langle K^*g, \varphi_\gamma\rangle + \frac{w_\gamma p}{2} |\langle f, \varphi_\gamma\rangle|^{p-1} \mathrm{sign}(\langle f, \varphi_\gamma\rangle) = 0$ for all $\gamma \in \Gamma$.

nodes.name: Minimizer of the surrogate functional
nodes.statement: Under $\|K^*K\| < 1$ and any $a \in \cH$, ${\Phi}^{\mathrm{SUR}}_{\mathbf{w},p}(\cdot; a)$ has a unique minimizer $f = \mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}(a + K^*(g - Ka))$, and ${\Phi}^{\mathrm{SUR}}_{\mathbf{w},p}(f + h; a) \geq {\Phi}^{\mathrm{SUR}}_{\mathbf{w},p}(f; a) + \|h\|^2$ for all $h$.

nodes.name: Non-expansivity of $\mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}$
nodes.statement: For all $v, v' \in \cH$, $\|\mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p} v - \mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p} v'\| \le \|v - v'\|$.
conclusions: $\|\mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p} v - \mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p} v'\| \le \|v - v'\|$ for all $v, v' \in \cH$

nodes.name: Iterative algorithm formula (Corollary 2.2)
nodes.statement: Under the hypotheses of Proposition 2.1, the iterates from the surrogate-minimization scheme satisfy $f^n = \mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}(f^{n-1} + K^*(g - Kf^{n-1}))$.

nodes.name: Generalization to diagonal operator $D$
nodes.statement: If $D$ is diagonal in the $\varphi_\gamma$-basis with $D \geq K^*K + \eta I$ for some $\eta > 0$, the same construction yields $f^n = \mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w}/\mathbf{d},p}(f^{n-1} + D^{-1}K^*(g - Kf^{n-1}))$.

nodes.name: Complex-valued functions (Remark 2.5)
nodes.statement: For complex $f_\gamma$, extending $S_{\mu,p}(re^{i\theta}) = S_{\mu,p}(r) e^{i\theta}$ preserves the formula $f_\gamma = S_{w_\gamma,p}(a_\gamma + [K^*(g - Ka)]_\gamma)$.

nodes.name: Strong convergence of iterative thresholded Landweber (Theorem 3.1)
nodes.statement: If $\|K\| < 1$, $1 \le p \le 2$, and $w_\gamma \ge c > 0$ uniformly, then $f^n = \mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}(f^{n-1} + K^*(g - Kf^{n-1}))$ converges strongly to a minimizer $f^*$ of $\Phi_{\mathbf{w},p}$. If $p > 1$ or $\mathrm{N}(K) = \{0\}$, the minimizer is unique and the limit is independent of $f^0$.
conclusions: $f^n$ converges strongly (in $\cH$-norm) to a minimizer of $\Phi_{\mathbf{w},p}$
If $p > 1$ or $\mathrm{N}(K) = \{0\}$, the minimizer $f^*$ is unique and $\lim f^n = f^*$ regardless of $f^0$

nodes.name: Opial's fixed-point theorem (cited)
nodes.statement: Let $\mathbf{A}: \cH \to \cH$ be (i) non-expansive, (ii) asymptotically regular, with (iii) non-empty fixed-point set $\mathcal{F}$. Then $(\mathbf{A}^n v)_{n \in \N}$ converges weakly to a fixed point in $\mathcal{F}$ for any $v \in \cH$.
conclusions: $(\mathbf{A}^n v)$ converges weakly to a fixed point of $\mathbf{A}$ for every $v \in \cH$

nodes.name: Weak limit of subsequence is fixed point (Lemma 3.2)
nodes.statement: If $\mathbf{A}$ is non-expansive and asymptotically regular, and a subsequence $(\mathbf{A}^{n_k} v)$ converges weakly, its weak limit is a fixed point of $\mathbf{A}$.
conclusions: Weak limit of $(\mathbf{A}^{n_k} v)$ is a fixed point of $\mathbf{A}$

nodes.name: Non-expansivity of $\mathbf{T}$ (Lemma 3.3)
nodes.statement: $\|\mathbf{T} v - \mathbf{T} v'\| \le \|v - v'\|$ for all $v, v' \in \cH$.

nodes.name: Monotone decrease of $\Phi_{\mathbf{w},p}(f^n)$ (Lemma 3.4)
nodes.statement: Both $(\Phi_{\mathbf{w},p}(f^n))_{n \in \N}$ and $({\Phi}^{\mathrm{SUR}}_{\mathbf{w},p}(f^{n+1}; f^n))_{n \in \N}$ are non-increasing.

nodes.name: Uniform boundedness of $\|f^n\|$ (Lemma 3.5)
nodes.statement: If $w_\gamma \ge c > 0$ uniformly, then $\|f^n\|$ is bounded uniformly in $n$.

nodes.name: Asymptotic regularity of $\mathbf{T}$ (Lemma 3.7)
nodes.statement: $\|\mathbf{T}^{n+1} f^0 - \mathbf{T}^n f^0\| = \|f^{n+1} - f^n\| \to 0$ as $n \to \infty$.

nodes.name: Weak convergence of $f^n$ to a fixed point
nodes.statement: The sequence $f^n = \mathbf{T}^n f^0$, $n = 1, 2, \ldots$ converges weakly, and its limit is a fixed point of $\mathbf{T}$.

nodes.name: Fixed point of $\mathbf{T}$ is a minimizer of $\Phi_{\mathbf{w},p}$
nodes.statement: If $f^* = \mathbf{T} f^*$, then $f^*$ minimizes $\Phi_{\mathbf{w},p}$.

nodes.name: Weak convergence summary (Proposition 3.10)
nodes.statement: Under the assumptions of Theorem 3.1, $f^n \rightharpoonup$ a minimizer of $\Phi_{\mathbf{w},p}$. If $\mathrm{N}(K) = \{0\}$ or $p > 1$, the minimizer is unique and all sequences converge weakly to it independently of $f^0$.
conclusions: $f^n$ converges weakly to a minimizer of $\Phi_{\mathbf{w},p}$

nodes.name: $\|Ku^n\| \to 0$ (Lemma 3.13)
nodes.statement: Setting $u^n = f^n - f^*$, $\|K u^n\| \to 0$ as $n \to \infty$.

nodes.name: Auxiliary bound for $\mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}(h + u^n)$ (Lemma 3.15)
nodes.statement: For $h = f^* + K^*(g - K f^*)$, $\|\mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}(h + u^n) - \mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}(h) - u^n\| \to 0$ as $n \to \infty$.

nodes.name: Norm-convergence under shrinkage residual decay (Lemma 3.16)
nodes.statement: If $v^n \rightharpoonup 0$ and $\|\mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}(a + v^n) - \mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}(a) - v^n\| \to 0$, then $\|v^n\| \to 0$ as $n \to \infty$.

nodes.name: Regularization theorem (Theorem 4.1)
nodes.statement: Under the standing assumptions, if $\mu(\epsilon) \to 0$ and $\epsilon^2/\mu(\epsilon) \to 0$, then $\sup_{\|g - Kf_o\|\le \epsilon} \|f^*_{\mu(\epsilon),\mathbf{w},p;g} - f^{\dagger}\| \to 0$ where $f^{\dagger}$ is the unique element of minimum $\Vvert\cdot\Vvert_{\mathbf{w},p}$-norm in $\mathrm{N}(K) + f_o$.
conclusions: $f^{\dagger}$ is the unique element of minimal $\Vvert\cdot\Vvert_{\mathbf{w},p}$-norm in $\{f: Kf = Kf_o\}$

nodes.name: Pointwise bound $|S_{w,p}(x) - x| \le \frac{wp}{2}|x|^{p-1}$ (Lemma 4.2)
nodes.statement: For $1 \le p \le 2$, $|S_{w,p}(x) - x| \le \frac{wp}{2}|x|^{p-1}$.

nodes.name: Weak + norm-equality implies norm convergence (Lemma 4.3)
nodes.statement: If $v_k \rightharpoonup v$ in $\cH$ and $\Vvert v_k\Vvert_{\mathbf{w},p} \to \Vvert v\Vvert_{\mathbf{w},p}$, then $\|v - v_k\| \to 0$.

nodes.name: Modulus of convergence vs. modulus of continuity (Proposition 4.4)
nodes.statement: $M(\epsilon, \rho) \le M_\mu(\epsilon, \rho) \le M(\epsilon + \epsilon', \rho + \rho')$ where $\epsilon' = (\epsilon^2 + \mu \rho^p)^{1/2}$ and $\rho' = (\rho^p + \epsilon^2/\mu)^{1/p}$.
assumptions: Standing assumptions of Section 4 (in particular $\mathrm{N}(K) = \{0\}$, $\Vvert f_o\Vvert_{\mathbf{w},p} \le \rho$, $\|g - Kf_o\| \le \epsilon$, $\mu > 0$)

nodes.name: Bilateral bracket bounds for $M(\epsilon, \rho)$ under spectral bounds on $K$ (Proposition 4.6)
nodes.statement: If $\sum_\gamma b_\gamma |h_\gamma|^2 \le \|Kh\|^2 \le \sum_\gamma B_\gamma |h_\gamma|^2$, then $\max_\gamma \min(\rho w_\gamma^{-1/p}, \epsilon B_\gamma^{-1/2}) \le M(\epsilon, \rho) \le \min_{\Gamma = \Gamma_1 \cup \Gamma_2} \sqrt{\epsilon^2/\min_{\Gamma_1} b_\gamma + \rho^2/\min_{\Gamma_2} w_\gamma^{2/p}}$.
assumptions: Existence of $0 < b_\gamma, B_\gamma < \infty$ with the spectral inequalities $\sum b_\gamma |h_\gamma|^2 \le \|Kh\|^2 \le \sum B_\gamma |h_\gamma|^2$

nodes.name: Convergence rate for smoothing operator with Besov prior
nodes.statement: Under the smoothness assumption $A_\ell^2 \sum 2^{-2|\lambda|\alpha} |h_\lambda|^2 \le \|Kh\|^2 \le A_u^2 \sum 2^{-2|\lambda|\alpha} |h_\lambda|^2$, $c (\epsilon/A_u)^{\sigma/(\sigma + \alpha)} \rho^{\alpha/(\sigma + \alpha)} \le M(\epsilon, \rho) \le C (\epsilon/A_\ell)^{\sigma/(\sigma + \alpha)} \rho^{\alpha/(\sigma + \alpha)}$, where $\sigma = s + d(\frac{1}{2} - \frac{1}{p}) \ge 0$.
assumptions: $K$ smoothing operator of order $\alpha$ in the Besov sense (DP111.16)

nodes.name: Proof of Proposition 2.1
nodes.statement: By substitution and case analysis on $\Gamma_0 = \{\gamma : f_\gamma = 0\}$ vs $\Gamma_1$, we show ${\Phi}^{\mathrm{SUR}}_{\mathbf{w},1}(f + h; a) - {\Phi}^{\mathrm{SUR}}_{\mathbf{w},1}(f; a) \geq \|h\|^2$, treating the $p = 1$ case in detail.

nodes.name: Proof of non-expansivity (Lemma 2.2)
nodes.statement: It suffices to show $|S_{w,p}(x) - S_{w,p}(x')| \le |x - x'|$. For $p > 1$, $F'_{w,p} \geq 1$ gives the bound. For $p = 1$ all cases are checked directly.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 3.1
nodes.statement: Combine weak convergence (Proposition PrP111.2 + PrP111.3) with the $\|Ku^n\| \to 0$ estimate (Lemma LP111.8) and Lemma LP111.10 to upgrade to norm convergence.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 4.1 (regularization)
nodes.statement: Establish weak convergence of $f^*_{\mu_n; g_n}$ via boundedness and Banach-Alaoglu, identify the weak limit as $f^{\dagger}$ via the fixed-point equation and Lemma 4.2, then upgrade to norm convergence via Lemma 4.3.

nodes.name: Proof of Proposition 4.4 (modulus of convergence bracket)
nodes.statement: Use $\Phi_{\mu;g}(f^*_{\mu;g}) \le \Phi_{\mu;g}(f_o) \le \epsilon^2 + \mu \rho^p$ to place $f^*_{\mu;g} \in \mathcal{F}(\epsilon', \rho')$, then triangle inequality and the choice $g = 0$ for the lower bound.

nodes.name: Proof of Proposition 4.6 (bracket bounds for $M$)
nodes.statement: Lower bound: exhibit single-coordinate $h = \nu \varphi_{\gamma_m}$ achieving the max-min. Upper bound: split $\Gamma$ into $\Gamma_1 \cup \Gamma_2$ and bound each piece using the spectral inequalities.

nodes.name: Proof of Besov-rate proposition
nodes.statement: Apply Proposition 4.6 with $b_\lambda = A_\ell^2 2^{-2|\lambda|\alpha}$ and $B_\lambda = A_u^2 2^{-2|\lambda|\alpha}$ and optimize over $|\lambda|$ (lower bound) or $J$ (upper bound).

nodes.name: Iterative thresholded Landweber algorithm
nodes.statement: Iterative matrix-free scheme: at each step apply $K^*$-residual update followed by component-wise shrinkage $\mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}$ to compute the minimizer of $\Phi_{\mathbf{w},p}$.
output: Sequence $(f^n)_{n \in \N}$ converging strongly to a minimizer $f^*$ of $\Phi_{\mathbf{w},p}$
nodes.pseudocode: f^0 arbitrary; for n = 1, 2, ...: f^n = S_{w,p}( f^{n-1} + K^*(g - K f^{n-1}) ); stop when ||f^n - f^{n-1}|| is small.

nodes.name: Landweber iteration (cited)
nodes.statement: $f^n = f^{n-1} + K^*(g - K f^{n-1})$, the classical iterative method for $K f = g$.
output: Sequence $(f^n)$ converging to the generalized solution of $Kf = g$

nodes.name: Sparsity-penalized regularized inverse problem
nodes.statement: Find $f^* = \arg\min_f \Phi_{\mathbf{w},p}(f) = \|Kf - g\|^2 + \sum_\gamma w_\gamma |\langle f, \varphi_\gamma\rangle|^p$ for $1 \le p \le 2$.

nodes.name: Pure-denoising special case ($K = I$, $p = 1$, $\mathbf{w} = \mu \mathbf{w}_0$)
nodes.statement: When $K$ is the identity, the minimizer is $f^* = \sum_\gamma S_\mu(g_\gamma) \varphi_\gamma$, recovering Donoho-Johnstone soft-threshold denoising.

nodes.name: Thresholded SVD expansion ($p = 1$)
nodes.statement: For compact $K$ with SVD $\{(u_k, v_k, \sigma_k)\}$, the minimizer of $\Phi_{\mu \mathbf{w}_0, 1}$ is $f^* = \sum_k \sigma_k^{-2} S_\mu(\sigma_k \langle g, u_k\rangle) v_k$.

nodes.name: 2D deconvolution illustration
nodes.statement: $256 \times 256$ image of four small bright ellipses convolved with a radially symmetric low-pass filter and corrupted with Poisson noise; reconstructed with 2000 iterations of the algorithm for $p = 1, 2$ with and without positivity constraint $P_{\mathcal{C}}$.

nodes.name: Positivity / convex-set projection extension
nodes.statement: If the object lies in a closed convex subset $\mathcal{C} \subset \cH$, replace $\mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}$ by $P_{\mathcal{C}} \mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}$ where $P_{\mathcal{C}}$ projects onto $\mathcal{C}$.

nodes.name: Numerical complexity of one iteration
nodes.statement: Each iteration costs $O(N^2)$ in general; $O(N)$ when $K^*K$ is sparse in $\varphi_\gamma$; $O(N \log N)$ if $K^*K$ is implementable via FFT (e.g., convolution with a wavelet basis).

nodes.name: Asymmetric penalty extension
nodes.statement: Replacing $w_\gamma |f_\gamma|^p$ by $w^+_\gamma [f_\gamma]_+^p + w^-_\gamma [f_\gamma]_-^p$ and using $S_{w^+, w^-, p}$ in place of $S_{w, p}$ preserves all results.

nodes.name: Set up shorthand $\mathbf{T}$ and notation $u^n = f^n - f^*$
nodes.statement: Define $\mathbf{T} f = \mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}(f + K^*(g - Kf))$ and let $f^*$ be the weak limit guaranteed by Proposition PrP111.2; set $u^n = f^n - f^*$ and $h = f^* + K^*(g - K f^*)$.

nodes.name: Establish $\|K u^n\| \to 0$
nodes.statement: Use $\|u^{n+1} - u^n\| \to 0$ (Lemma 3.7) and non-expansivity of $\mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}$ to derive $\|u^n\| - \|(I - K^*K) u^n\| \to 0$, then conclude $\|K u^n\|^2 \to 0$ (Lemma 3.13).

nodes.name: Reduce to shrinkage residual identity
nodes.statement: From the bound on $\|\mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}(h + u^n - K^*K u^n) - \mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}(h) - u^n\|$ and $\|K u^n\| \to 0$, deduce $\|\mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}(h + u^n) - \mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}(h) - u^n\| \to 0$ (Lemma 3.15).

nodes.name: Apply Lemma 3.16 to conclude norm convergence
nodes.statement: With $u^n \rightharpoonup 0$ and the shrinkage-residual decay from PSP111.3, Lemma 3.16 (LP111.10) gives $\|u^n\| \to 0$, i.e. $f^n \to f^*$ in norm.

nodes.name: Establish uniform boundedness of $f^*_{\mu_n; g_n}$
nodes.statement: From $f^*_{\mu_n; g_n}$ minimizing $\Phi_{\mu_n; g_n}$ and $K f^{\dagger} = K f_o$, derive $\|f^*_{\mu_n; g_n}\|^p \le c^{-1}(\epsilon_n^2/\mu_n + \Vvert f^{\dagger}\Vvert_{\mathbf{w},p}^p)$, which is bounded under (4.4).

nodes.name: Extract weakly convergent subsequence
nodes.statement: By Banach-Alaoglu the bounded sequence has a weakly convergent subsequence $\widetilde{f}_k \rightharpoonup \widetilde{f}$ with controlled $\Vvert\widetilde{f}_k\Vvert_{\mathbf{w},p}$.

nodes.name: Identify weak limit $\widetilde{f}$ via fixed-point equation and Lemma 4.2
nodes.statement: Since each $\widetilde{f}_k$ is a fixed point of $\mathbf{T}_{\widetilde{\mu}_k}$, taking limits and using $|S_{\widetilde{\mu}_k w_\gamma, p}(x) - x| \le \frac{p w_\gamma \widetilde{\mu}_k}{2}|x|^{p-1}$ yields $K^*K(f^{\dagger} - \widetilde{f}) = 0$, hence $f^{\dagger} - \widetilde{f} \in \mathrm{N}(K)$.

nodes.name: Equate triple-bar norms via Fatou and the upper bound
nodes.statement: Fatou's lemma gives $\Vvert\widetilde{f}\Vvert_{\mathbf{w},p}^p \le \liminf \Vvert\widetilde{f}_k\Vvert_{\mathbf{w},p}^p \le \Vvert f^{\dagger}\Vvert_{\mathbf{w},p}^p \le \Vvert\widetilde{f}\Vvert_{\mathbf{w},p}^p$, forcing all three to coincide.

nodes.name: Conclude $\widetilde{f} = f^{\dagger}$ and upgrade to norm convergence
nodes.statement: Uniqueness of the minimum $\Vvert\cdot\Vvert_{\mathbf{w},p}$-norm element in $\mathcal{S}$ forces $\widetilde{f} = f^{\dagger}$, and Lemma 4.3 (norm-from-weak) gives $\|f^*_{\mu_n; g_n} - f^{\dagger}\| \to 0$.

nodes.name: Initialize $f^0$
nodes.statement: Choose $f^0 \in \cH$ arbitrarily (often $f^0 = 0$).

nodes.name: Iterative update loop
nodes.statement: For $n = 1, 2, \ldots$: compute residual $r^{n-1} = g - K f^{n-1}$, update $a^n = f^{n-1} + K^* r^{n-1}$, then apply component-wise shrinkage $f^n = \mathbf{S}_{\mathbf{w},p}(a^n) = \sum_\gamma S_{w_\gamma, p}(\langle a^n, \varphi_\gamma\rangle) \varphi_\gamma$.

nodes.name: Stop and return $f^n$
nodes.statement: Stop when $\|f^n - f^{n-1}\|$ falls below a tolerance; return $f^n$ as approximation to the minimizer of $\Phi_{\mathbf{w},p}$.
